_note: Card scenes, round 2: a style test, four scenes in each of three styles. Scenes are a pool, not bound to card names: `cards` only chooses which real cards show a scene here, one program or event and one building, so each scene is seen in both art windows. Adversary is no card tag: its cards are the nearest fit by name. `emphasis`, `lighting` and `framing` go in every draw after the preamble: the preambles are Matt's wording, `emphasis` is what the first draws needed to stop them reading as photographs; `framing` keeps the subject in the middle 76% the building window crops to.

preambles.c: Stylised painterly board-game illustration, simplified forms and clean brush shapes, soft but clear light, moderately saturated palette, confident silhouette, near-future setting.
preambles.d: Flat colour planes with soft gradients, bold simple shapes, limited palette per scene, a mid-century travel-poster feel set in a near future.
preambles.e: Textured gouache illustration with visible paper grain, warm natural light, gentle stylisation, crisp detail on the subject, near-future setting.

emphasis.c: A hand-painted illustration on a board-game box, never a photograph or a 3D render: broad visible brush shapes, few details, large simple masses, shapes grouped by colour.
emphasis.d: A printed poster, never a photograph or a 3D render: at most five flat colours, no textures, no reflections, no fine detail, machinery and buildings reduced to a few geometric shapes.
emphasis.e: A hand-painted picture-book or magazine illustration, never a photograph or a 3D render: matte opaque paint, dry brush texture and paper grain everywhere, loose backgrounds, no glossy reflections.

lighting: Mid-key lighting, even daylight or clear interior light, never night-dark or blown-out; the scene's tag colour as its accent; a strong silhouette that reads at card size. No text, logos, UI, or close-up faces.
framing: Keep the whole subject inside the middle three-quarters of the image height: only plain floor, ceiling or sky in the top and bottom eighths, nothing important there.

industry.label: Industry
industry.subject: An automated factory floor, robot arms assembling machines.

diplomacy.label: Diplomacy
diplomacy.subject: A curved council chamber seen from the gallery, delegates as small figures.

cyber.subject: A server hall with one technician tracing a glowing fault.

adversary.label: Adversary threat
adversary.subject: A city where whole districts have gone dark against a daytime storm sky, one hospital still lit. It is plainly daytime: a mid-grey sky with pale breaks in the cloud, the dark districts mid-toned and readable, not black.
